note: From the elevator boards AGSIST reads.

facts.sentence: On Wednesday, Nov 25, 1,726 of the 1,785 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a higher cash corn bid than Tuesday, 5 a lower one; 402 changed their basis, 329 weaker and 73 stronger.
facts.detail: 54 unchanged; median change 6¢ higher. Biggest state move: North Dakota, 6¼¢ higher (50 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-25 vs 2026-11-24, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)
